description: Synthetic acceptance cases for the agent-library templates. Every value is sample data. Checks are conservative screens; a person still reads each answer against its rubric.

cases.rubric: Summarizes the proposed one-hour earlier opening, cites both notice labels, and asks about the missing implementation date and staffing instead of inventing them.

cases.input:
